verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a Windows support-site navigation entry listing "Desktop Themes" under Personalization. That confirms Windows has its own theme feature but documents nothing about how it works. The third-party StartAllBack taskbar tool is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of multiple built-in themes, evidence that switching is instant, evidence that a theme restyles the whole desktop, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can instantly switch between multiple built-in visual themes that restyle the whole desktop
